scope: Prescribed K1 elbow, cap swivels and carriage coordinates with the same fixed mesh list as K7. Original rails, eight fixed-end wires, no spring, moving cuff or deformed TPU. K1 return is the reverse of the checked outward path. Source spacing may exceed one degree. The final bracket is interpolated between neighboring trace rows at no more than 0.1 degree; no interpolated dynamics. Effective moment arm follows the coupled elbow/carriage trajectory, not the isolated elbow moment. K7 long-rail trial checks added material against rigid geometry, eight wires and the 10 N cuff pose and chord. TPU and assembly under load remain open.
